relations.subject: Per Kværne
relations.evidence: In 1970 he received the mag.art. degree in Sanskrit at the University of Oslo.

relations.subject: Per Kværne
relations.role: lecturer in the history of religion
relations.evidence: From 1970 to 1975 he worked as a lecturer in the history of religion at the University of Bergen.

relations.subject: Per Kværne
relations.evidence: In 1973 he received the dr.philos. degree from the University of Oslo with his thesis An Anthology of Buddhist Tantric Songs.

relations.subject: Per Kværne
relations.role: professor of the history of religion
relations.evidence: From 1975 to 2007 he was professor of the history of religion at the University of Oslo, and he is now a professor emeritus.

relations.subject: Per Kværne
relations.object: Institute for Comparative Research in Human Culture, Oslo
relations.evidence: From 1992 he served as chairman of the board of the Institute for Comparative Research in Human Culture, Oslo.

relations.subject: Per Kværne
relations.evidence: From April 2007 to May 2008 he served as dean of Study at the St. Eystein Priest Seminar.
